suhrawardi.oneLineEn: Recast Ibn Sina, Platonic light metaphysics, and knowledge by presence into Illuminationist Islamic philosophy.

ibn-arabi.oneLineEn: Shaped Islamic mystical metaphysics via oneness of being, Perfect Human, imagination, and divine names.

han-feizi.oneLineEn: Systematized late Warring States Legalism by uniting law, statecraft, power, and forms-and-names doctrine.

huineng.oneLineEn: Shaped Southern Chan via sudden enlightenment, self-nature, no-thought, and nondual samadhi-prajna (Platform Sutra).

zhang-zai.oneLineEn: Founded Northern Song qi ontology through Great Void as qi, all people as siblings, and virtue cultivation practice.
keywordsEn: all people as siblings, all things as companions

dignaga.oneLineEn: Founded Buddhist pramana theory, limiting valid cognition to perception and inference, with apoha semantics.

wollstonecraft.oneLineEn: Critiqued Enlightenment gender order through women's rational education and civic equality.

anscombe.oneLineEn: Helped revive virtue ethics through analysis of intentional action and critique of modern moral philosophy.

rosenzweig.oneLineEn: Countered totalizing systems in The Star of Redemption and opened a modern Jewish dialogical philosophy.

fanon.oneLineEn: Linked existentialism and postcolonial thought through colonial psychology and theories of national liberation.

freire.oneLineEn: Founded critical pedagogy through dialogue, conscientization, and critique of banking-model education.

horkheimer.oneLineEn: Recast Marxist social philosophy as a diagnosis of modernity via critical theory and critique of instrumental reason.

adorno.oneLineEn: Exposed social domination in identity thinking via negative dialectics, culture industry, and modernist aesthetics.

benjamin.oneLineEn: Remade media-critical modernity via art under mechanical reproduction, history, and urban fragment writing.

cohen.oneLineEn: Linked Kantian tradition to Rosenzweig via Marburg Neo-Kantianism and Jewish rational religion philosophy.

eckhart.oneLineEn: Pushed scholastic theology into German mysticism's core via detachment, poverty of spirit, and mystical union.
keywordsEn: birth of God in the soul

cusa.oneLineEn: Moved medieval theology toward Renaissance metaphysics via learned ignorance, coincidence of opposites, and infinity.

vico.oneLineEn: Opened history, law, myth, and language as a human-made world through verum factum and the New Science.

herder.oneLineEn: Critiqued abstract universalism via language, national spirit, and historical individuality; shaped German historicism.

iqbal.oneLineEn: Answered modernity's religion and self problems via self-philosophy, Islamic reconstruction, and poetic politics.
